item.title: Richard Turgeon — Fri Oct 23, 8:00 PM — Old Western Saloon
item.description:
Richard Turgeon is a San Francisco-based singer/songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and record producer. His alternative rock sound has been called "California Rock" or "New Vintage Rock," is regularly featured on SiriusXM, and has been featured in indie film soundtracks. He's currently playing live shows in the Bay Area and beyond with his trio, RT3.
Last year he played drums for national act Donnie Emerson, subject of the film "Dreamin' Wild," and Pavement co-founder Scott Kannberg recently shared Rich's cover/video of Pavement's song "Date with IKEA."
His critically acclaimed solo records from the last several years have made innumerable “best of” lists from various press outlets, radio stations and bloggers from around the world. Visit his website at www.richardturgeon.com
Source: North Bay Bohemian

With an upbeat blend of infectiously danceable original alternative rock and classic hits, we'll have you rocking from 9PM to midnight at one of Cotati's best bars and music venues!

item.description:
Join Dolphin Charters for a 3 hr narrated trip on the Petaluma River. View the commercial aspects of this waterway as we depart the Petaluma Turning Basin, head downriver, and enter a different world of wetlands and oxbows. Learn about the history and importance of the river to the town of Petaluma and the surrounding countryside, and why it is still important today. Look around you to see the birds and wildlife that inhabit this special region as we cruise on our downriver and return journey. Children must be 8 years of age or older and cost is $55/person

Join us for the inaugural Hallowine Walk: Trick, Treat & Taste in Yountville, where wine, Halloween, and small-town charm come together for a one-of-a-kind fall experience.
Your ticket includes a commemorative wine cup, event wristband, and tasting map. Costumes are encouraged, so gather your friends, dress in your Halloween best, and enjoy an unforgettable afternoon of wine, treats, and festive fun!

item.description:

Rooted in the traditional Mexican celebration of life and remembrance, the event invites guests to bring photos of departed family and friends to place on a communal altar, with frames provided. Festive activities, live music, and the atmosphere of a traditional Mexican pueblo will fill the plaza, while authentic Mexican cuisine paired with Keller Estate wines creates a warm and memorable gathering. This heartfelt celebration offers a beautiful opportunity to reflect, connect, and honor cherished memories together.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Petaluma River Cruise — Sun Oct 25, 10:00 AM — Petaluma Turning Basin
item.description:
Join Dolphin Charters for a 3 hr narrated trip on the Petaluma River. View the commercial aspects of this waterway as we depart the Petaluma Turning Basin, head downriver, and enter a different world of wetlands and oxbows. Learn about the history and importance of the river to the town of Petaluma and the surrounding countryside, and why it is still important today. Look around you to see the birds and wildlife that inhabit this special region as we cruise on our downriver and return journey. Children must be 8 years of age or older and cost is $55/person
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
